description:
VICE emulator operations.

Operations:
- resource_get: Read a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required inputs: name.
- resource_set [write]: Write a VICE configuration resource (safe prefixes only). Required inputs: name, value.
- snapshot_save [write]: Save snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- snapshot_restore [destructive]: Restore snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- version: VICE version.
